grace: Heads-up team  Aquatech flagged INV-AQ-2026-02-21: promo STACK-ONBOARD appears to have been applied twice resulting in a net overcredit of $9,750. Partner is asking for a cash refund rather than a debit memo because they need funds to reimburse their customers. Need GL treatment and sign-off flow.
billing-bot: Alert: rule promo_duplicate_chain v5  invoice INV-AQ-2026-02-21 duplicate promo_id STACK-ONBOARD detected.
tom-finance: can you paste the invoice lines so I can confirm amounts?
grace: CSV excerpt pasted below:```
INV-AQ-2026-02-21 | Aquatech | LineItem: DEDICATED-GPU | 19,500.00 | qty 1
INV-AQ-2026-02-21 | Aquatech | Promo: STACK-ONBOARD | -9,750.00 | promo_id:STACK-ONBOARD
INV-AQ-2026-02-21 | Aquatech | Promo: STACK-ONBOARD | -9,750.00 | promo_id:STACK-ONBOARD  <-- duplicated on partner + customer layers
Invoice balance: -9,750.00 (we owe customer)
```
irene-partners: thanks. Quick policy check: finance prefers debit memo (contra-revenue) when partner agrees. Cash refunds reserved for cases where partner refuses reversal or there is an operational inability to issue a debit memo.
lucas-accounting: GL consequences differ: debit memo (promo reversal) posts as contra-revenue. Suggested entry: DEBIT 4-2200 Promotional Contra $9,750 / CREDIT 1-1100 Accounts Receivable $9,750. Cash refund posts as expense: DEBIT 6-5000 Customer Refunds $9,750 / CREDIT 1-1020 Cash $9,750. Which path is partner requesting?
maya-cs: Aquatech told our CS: "We need cash now to refund a critical customer who already paid out. A debit memo won't help our cashflow." They attached an email from their CFO saying refund preferred.
tom-finance: noted. Two forks: (A) Push for debit memo (preferred, keeps revenue clean); (B) approve one-time cash refund (requires Finance Director + Partnerships + Legal sign-off, and CFO flagged if >10k). This case is $9,750 so under 10k but close.
legal: Quick check: if we do cash refund we need a release language and proof Aquatech will not pursue further claims. Draft language: "Customer refund issued to partner to correct duplicate promo application; partner releases Redwood from further claims related to INV-AQ-2026-02-21." Legal ok with quick review.
irene-partners: Partner ops said they would accept a debit memo if we can issue it immediately and provide a partner-facing note they can use with their customer. They prefer a refund but are open.
grace: Can accounting do a debit memo same-day? We have NetSuite batch at EOD.
lucas-accounting: We can post a NetSuite reversal today if memo is signed. For audit, need original invoice PDF and partner sign-off attached. If partner insists on cash refund, we need a payment request and additional approvals.
tom-finance: propose this workflow: try debit memo first. Draft DM referencing INV-AQ-2026-02-21 and case RC-AQ-2026-210. Route to Partner CFO + Partnerships lead. If partner insists on cash refund, escalate to Finance Director for one-off approval and Legal for release.
billing-bot: Action logged: reversal_case RC-AQ-2026-210 created amount 9750 status:pending_partner_choice. Customer notifications suppressed to avoid confusion.
maya-cs: I'll message Aquatech with option for debit memo today (we can provide partner note + invoice language) and ask for firm preference within 4 business hours. They said they can sign a memo quickly if that helps.
legal: if partner signs debit memo acceptance, we don't need the full refund release text. Just ensure memo includes partner acceptance language.
irene-partners: approve the proposed workflow. If partner signs the memo, Partnerships will countersign and we proceed to NetSuite reversal.
grace: I'll draft the debit memo text: "Debit Memo DM-AQ-2026-02A: reversal of duplicate application of STACK-ONBOARD on INV-AQ-2026-02-21. Amount: $9,750. Partner acceptance required." Routing to Aquatech CFO now.
tom-finance: GL for posting after memo signed: DEBIT 4-2200 Promotional Contra $9,750 / CREDIT 1-1100 AR $9,750. Tag partner code AQ-311 and contract AQ-CON-77. Include original invoice and partner ack in journal attachments.
maya-cs: Aquatech replied: "We prefer cash refund due to immediate customer repayment obligations, but will accept debit memo if cash refund is not possible within 48 hours."
lucas-accounting: if cash refund requested, operationally we can wire funds but need the extra approvals. Also will require payment ticket and cash account reconciliation.
legal: draft release attached to this thread. If partner signs release, Legal ok to proceed with refund.
tom-finance: I'm going to flag this for Finance Director sign-off if partner insists on refund. Please keep thread updated.
billing-bot: Note: engineering ticket created to patch promo stacking pathway (B-4321) to prevent recurrence.
grace: closing for now; will re-open after partner confirms preference and we have signed documentation. Thanks all. :handshake:"
